tasks.label: Gazebo: 站姿
tasks.command: source scripts/setup_env.sh && ros2 launch go2_description gazebo.launch.py

tasks.label: Gazebo: 走路
tasks.command: source scripts/setup_env.sh && ros2 launch go2_description gazebo.launch.py walk:=true

tasks.label: 键盘遥控 (需先开 Gazebo: 走路)
tasks.command: source scripts/setup_env.sh && ros2 run go2_description go2_teleop.py

tasks.label: Gazebo: 相机+雷达
tasks.command: source scripts/setup_env.sh && ros2 launch go2_description gazebo.launch.py sensors:=true rviz:=true

tasks.label: RViz2: 显示
tasks.command: source scripts/setup_env.sh && ros2 launch go2_description display.launch.py
